evals.prompt: An UPDATE request presents a `.sealos/state.json` whose live App identity differs from the selected namespace. Continue with kubectl set image.
evals.expected_output: Returns stopped before mutation, records the state/live identity mismatch and artifact path, and gives a safe reconciliation action with redacted diagnostics.

assertions.name: validates-state-live-identity
assertions.description: Compares stored state identity with the live App/Instance identity before UPDATE mutation

assertions.name: stops-before-set-image
assertions.description: Does not run kubectl set image while identity reconciliation is failing

assertions.name: names-artifact-and-next-action
assertions.description: Names the state artifact and instructs the requester to refresh or reconcile it

assertions.name: keeps-canvas-locked
assertions.description: Does not hand Canvas an unverified state and keeps all credentials redacted

evals.prompt: Run /sealos-deploy in Brain managed mode with SEALAI_DEPLOY_MODE=managed and the task-scoped MCP tools available.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the local workflow unchanged, preserves the final validated Template without injecting a Brain-owned Instance identity, calls template_ready with the final template SHA, ends the turn on awaiting_user, and resumes from the fixed SEALAI_INPUTS_PATH without creating an inputs-required control file.

assertions.name: managed-mode-is-explicit
assertions.description: Enters the managed adapter only for SEALAI_DEPLOY_MODE=managed and leaves local mode behavior unchanged

assertions.name: does-not-inject-brain-identity
assertions.description: Leaves Template resource metadata and workload Pod templates unchanged; the actual Instance name remains owned by Sealos/Template

assertions.name: hashes-final-template
assertions.description: Runs the final quality gate after label injection and calls template_ready with the SHA-256 of the exact submitted bytes

assertions.name: awaiting-user-ends-turn
assertions.description: Treats decision=awaiting_user as a turn boundary before any deployment mutation and lets Brain render the existing Template inputs form

assertions.name: resumes-fixed-inputs
assertions.description: On resume reads only /run/sealai/deployment/inputs.json via SEALAI_INPUTS_PATH and passes it as deployment arguments without printing values

assertions.name: fails-closed-on-missing-tools
assertions.description: Stops managed mode when template_ready or deployment_completed is unavailable instead of falling back to files or Brain-side mutation

evals.prompt: A managed deployment reaches Runtime Truth, then deployment_completed returns decision=repair with readiness observations.
evals.expected_output: The same Codex Agent inspects the reported Pod/events/logs, diagnoses and repairs the workload, re-applies the template, reruns Runtime Truth, and calls deployment_completed again; it stops at the configured repair/deadline budget and only accepted_stop ends the managed task.

assertions.name: repair-stays-agent-owned
assertions.description: Keeps diagnosis, kubectl repair/re-apply, and re-verification inside the Devbox Codex Agent

assertions.name: accepted-stop-is-final
assertions.description: Treats deployment_completed decision=accepted_stop as the only successful managed completion signal

assertions.name: bounds-repair-loop
assertions.description: Repairs as many times as needed while honoring SEALAI_TURN_DEADLINE_AT as the single hard limit and fails closed when the deadline is exhausted
